blocks.text: Two days at leisure to relax on the beach, explore the surrounding area or simply enjoy the laid-back atmosphere of Praia do Forte. One of Brazil’s most attractive coastal destinations, it lies about 60 kilometres north of Salvador on the Coconut Coast, with beautiful beaches, tropical surroundings and a relaxed atmosphere, the perfect place to unwind after exploring Salvador.
